objective: Determine source-bound feasibility of equality of four campaign servo-minus-free expected torque differences using the minimum contrast uncertainty C.
prior_knowledge: Table 15 and published offsets, PRs 47-50 results and the supplied September 10 planning specification are known. This is not outcome-independent protocol selection. Earlier numerical results are not inputs.

source_contract.comparison_detail: Sections 3 and 9 describe the same recovered torque difference in each campaign; source does not establish every correction-stage and residual loading needed for a completed mean/uncertainty model. No demonstrated mismatch is asserted.
source_contract.precision_scope: exact reported decimals only; no restored physical precision; future rounding/statistical calibration separate
source_contract.uncertainty_interpretation: Type A marginal standard uncertainties; other source assignments include conservative and noncentered effects; no complete campaign matrix.

synthetic_fixtures.calibration: Synthetic only; no observed torque inputs; baseline/equivalent survive; distinct faulty matrix-scale calibration killed.

synthetic_fixtures.joint_input_model: J=I8; U=V1; compare direct C, V_d,V_y,J_U

uncertainty_policy.all_admissible: Finite complete unknown-loading span; A L=0 removes variances and cross terms for all joint completions; equality of two examples is insufficient.
uncertainty_policy.exact_arithmetic: standard library Fraction; reject floats, booleans, nonfinite, duplicate keys and malformed dimensions
uncertainty_policy.forbidden_transfer: Tables 14,17,18 and four-final-result correlations are not campaign torque covariance.
uncertainty_policy.matrix_validity: Exact symmetry, all principal minors for PSD, rank/nullspace; invalid code matrices are errors, faithful conflicting published matrices are source limitations.
uncertainty_policy.mean_correction: UNKNOWN blocks; SPECIFIED_NOT_APPLIED requires an explicit source rule and residual mean scope but no actual outcome correction.
uncertainty_policy.meaning: Centered covariance, conservative uncertainty, second moment, interval and bound remain distinct. Nonremoved shift is not centered covariance.
uncertainty_policy.scope: Type A matrix alone cannot imply combined coverage; omitted effects must be source-specified absent/included or proven annihilated.
uncertainty_policy.summation: One joint J/U model retains cross terms; no unlicensed sum of independent components.
uncertainty_policy.units: Covariance conversion squared; signed sensitivities retain units.
uncertainty_policy.unknowns: Explicit null/loading/covariance/dependence records; never zero by omission.
